verifications.note: Reproduced on 83860be (QA2-N11 fails: validator accepts a verification bound to a pre-freeze LOAD run). Fixed in 540b3c69: closure is read from the reviewer's own verifications sidecar; findings.json must mirror the reviewer's own round record invocation; that run is bound to the record's assignment and the round's frozen_at; fix_revision must be an ancestor of the round and gate candidates. My independent QA3-R204 (findings.json cites the LOAD run -> 'not the verifying reviewer's own run') and QA3-R204b (sidecar moved to a round-1 record rebound to the LOAD run -> 'started 11:00Z, before the candidate froze') pass, and so does the in-repo test 'F-DG0-110 / F-DG0-204'. The residual metadata-rewrite path is tracked separately as F-DG0-208 (Low).

Reproduced on 83860be (QA2-N12 fails: outside-repo symlink accepted as evidence). Fixed: repoFile() compares the realpath with the realpath of the root. QA3-R205 passes: review evidence reached through a directory symlink that leaves the repo is rejected, and an in-repo relative symlink to a tracked file is still accepted, so there is no over-rejection.

Reproduced on 83860be (QA2-N14 prints 'exec-bit change detected by candidate: false'). Fixed: each manifest entry carries the git mode, and candidateId() hashes '<sha256>  <mode>  <path>' and refuses entries without a valid mode. QA3-R206 (committed chmod +x after freeze -> candidate error), QA3-N21 (mode flipped in the manifest -> tampered) and QA3-N22 (entry without mode -> 'lacks a valid mode') pass. The D-005 text drift is tracked as F-DG0-209 (Low).
